name: file-analyzer
title: File Analyzer
description: Analyze files, count lines of code, detect file types, and generate file statistics.
author: JARVIS Team

actions.name: analyze_file
actions.description: Analyze a file and return statistics (lines, type, size, encoding).

path.description: Path to the file to analyze.

actions.name: count_lines
actions.description: Count lines of code in source files.

extensions.description: Comma-separated file extensions to include (e.g., py,js,java).

actions.name: generate_report
actions.description: Generate a detailed file analysis report and save it.

output_path.description: Path to save the report (JSON or CSV).
